summary: Hymson Laser Technology Group Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells lasers and automation equipment in China and internationally. The company offers coating and calendaring and slitting, high-speed laser notching intelligent, high speed laser ablation, and high speed winding machine, as well as intelligent solutions for assembly line, solutions for the top-cover assembly of the battery, auto battery baking solutions, and EV battery module/pack for EV battery applications; 3C battery, transformer, VCM, electronic atomization, PCB/SMT, precision structural parts, brittle material, dispensing, and new display machines for consumer electronic applications.
